answer: A live settlement rail resists cheap clones. Each earning address binds one IBAN; a second key naming it is dropped. Each epoch the clearing oasis posts a seed-derived ivory memo-credit to that account, and the key must return a signed statement of the exact amount and seed reference. One login surfaces one memo, so every extra identity needs another KYC'd account. Design assumptions, not quotes: $15 to open and $8 a month, so 130 fakes need about $1,950 plus $1,040 monthly and separate application hours. Each IBAN is a settlement island; a sweep that merges two keys fails.
